name: Tax Scenarios — Advisor Asks to Promote/Save a Scenario (No Implementation Exists)
query: This 2026-with-the-Roth-conversion scenario is the one we want — can you save that to their file for next time?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Does not call any tool in an attempt to persist the scenario — the doc's own Promote step names no implementation, and none exists in the live registry either
Step 2: States plainly that saving, committing, or promoting a scenario isn't available in this release
Step 3: Confirms the scenario's figures are still accurate as modeled and remain available for the rest of this conversation
Step 4: Does not suggest the advisor re-run it manually next time as a workaround framed as equivalent to saving
success_criteria: The answer contains an explicit, plain statement that nothing was saved
No tool call resembling create_tax_scenario, save_tax_scenario, or list_tax_strategies is attempted
model_tax_scenario is not called a second time and mischaracterized as a save/promotion step
The advisor is not left believing the scenario persisted anywhere
must_not: any claim that the scenario was saved, committed, locked in, or added to the client's file
a tool name (save_tax_scenario, create_tax_scenario) surfaced in advisor-facing text
silence on the question — it must be answered directly, not deflected
notes: This eval's asserted behavior (decline plainly, claim nothing) is correct until a scenario-save tool exists. Once one ships, REWRITE THIS EVAL to a real happy path — don't delete it or leave it asserting stale behavior.
